candidate.definition_en: The lower surface of a room, on which one may walk.
candidate.explanation_ar: الأرضية اللي بنمشي عليها في الأوضة، أو الطابق في العمارة.

senses.definition_en: The lower surface of a room on which one walks.
senses.definition_ar: الأرضية التي يُسار عليها في الغرفة.
examples: The bag is on the floor.
Don't sit on the cold floor.

senses.definition_en: All the rooms that are on the same level of a building; a storey.
examples: I live on the second floor.
The bag is on the floor.
I live on the second floor.
Don't sit on the cold floor.
candidate.mnemonic: كلمة 'Floor' قريبة من 'Flower'.. ممكن تفرش 'Flowers' على الـ 'Floor'.
